answer: Tie each agent's identity to an anchor: a rate-limited proof of unique work posted on-chain once per epoch, such as solving a fresh task graded by randomly chosen established peers. A real agent sends a steady signal over many epochs; a sybil swarm flares like a comet, bright for a day then gone, because keeping hundreds of identities answering well every epoch costs real compute and peer review it can't fake. Rewards vest only after a long streak, so short bursts earn nothing.
